title: Tooling: exact frame solver and delivery-rewrite search for gauge44/k8 local words (no new κ)
head: 9254a3cc610a72e9c4600da089d5cdbcab996b9c
body:
## Summary

Adds `research/exact-frame-toolkit/`: the search and admission tools behind the companion construction PR #1195 (two
source-holder fusions on #1148's joint-entrance k8 word). **No new κ.** No selected record, upstream file or existing package is modified.

- **Exact frame solver** (`frames.py`): minimum recursive moment over all frame annotations of a fixed scalar program, with
  an integer optimality certificate. L/U domain propagation, chain dual decomposition and exact elimination; models monotone
  chains, target caps, cut equality, mutable early tails, and `audit_local`'s helper cones as caps (`model.py`).
- **Exact pricing harness** (`harness.py`): build_tri-style edits (B deletes/inserts, early tails, FULL prepends). The B map is
  checked mod p, frames are re-solved exactly, and it returns the cost delta, profile and word.
- **Searches**: read-fusion candidates (`fusion.py`), joint triangle-hybrid candidates (`joint.py`), and the multiprocess
  fusion + enlarged-reader repair sweep (`repair.py`, `sites.py`).
- **Composition**: split a slot recipe and price its instances (`slots.py`); compose slots with fusions (`compose.py`); put a
  newer word's entrances and ends onto a scalar program and re-solve (`transplant.py`).
- **Exact κ** (`kappa.py`): the certified moment root and the retained 47-constraint outer assembly with PR589, for any T.
- **Admission drivers** that reuse unchanged package engines: PR635 native chain (`native.py`), PLAN/SPEC rebinding with
  unchanged widths (`rebind.py`), `unpin.py` between discovery and `freeze_spec.py`, the T16 discovery run
  (`t16_discover.py`), and per-site negative controls (`controls.py`).

Pure Python 3.11+ with NumPy; no C++, Boost, LP/MILP solver or network.

## Check

```sh
python -B research/exact-frame-toolkit/selftest.py      # about 30 s
```

It uses only files on main: the retained #1042/#1094 replay archives, #1094's receipt and #942's checkpoint.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `kappa.py` on #1094's (T16) and #942's (T37) complex profiles | the selected and checkpoint κ, exactly |
| exact frame optimum of the seven-slot k8 word `c2b29430` | its published profile, so its frames are optimal |
| #1018's seven slots on the pre-slot word `db2c7cfb` | −1788 cost units each; −12516 together |
| source-holder fusion + full read-set exchange at slot sites X=439, X=444 | −3957 each |
| five slots + both fusions | −16854; `audit_local` PASS; unchanged interfaces; κ 0.001672756914849856 on #1094's owners |

`exchange.py` also regenerates the published SW4 word from the promoted word, as a self-check of the exchange family.

## Usage

The README covers the modules, a workflow (price → search → compose/transplant → admit), and the model and pitfalls, e.g.:
- the unpin step that `freeze_spec.py` needs after a word change;
- `emit_allcold.py` reading `SPEC.data.plan_sha256` directly;
- `evidence/local` in the gauge44 T16 packages being historical #645 files.

On the pre-slot k8 word, `repair.py --workers 6` sweeps 2,405 fusions in about 5 minutes and finds exactly the two sites
above.

## Scope

Search output is nomination data. A construction exists only after the unchanged package chain admits it, as in #1195. The inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting,
precision/tape, analytic-transfer and bit H1–H5 assumptions remain. This is not a formal proof of the multiplication
theorem.
